Receipts, not promises

The proof is in the people.

Real people, real numbers, coached across Europe. Some online, some in the gym with me.

Off the Dominos
Darren

He said he didn’t want to look like he lived off Dominos.

That was the brief, in his own words. He was in a rut and what he actually wanted was to feel good again, not a six pack. We fixed the food around his week first and the rest of it followed.

Coached properly
Steven

He had been through other coaches before me.

What he said at the end was that every workout was tailored to him and that I checked in constantly. That is the part the previous ones skipped. He scored the coaching five out of five and said he would work with me again.

Skinny fat to lean
Ross

Skinny fat, and stuck there for years.

He carried the weight but had none of the shape underneath it, which is where a lot of lads sit and never get out of. He turned it round properly. Same bloke, completely different body.

Gaining → fat loss
Devin

He had never trained a day in his life.

We built the muscle from nothing first, which is the unglamorous bit nobody puts on Instagram. Then we took 10kg off him and kept every bit of that muscle. He is not finished either, not even close.

140kg deadlift
Craig

He couldn't get up the stairs with his daughter.

Office job, five year old, permanently knackered. Going upstairs with her on his hip left him out of breath and his back aching. He now carries her on his shoulders without thinking about it. Started as a complete beginner and pulls 140kg off the floor.

4 stone down
Scott

130kg, and his knees were in bits.

He had never set foot in a gym. Two hundred metres on the skier left him soaked and struggling, and his knees couldn't cope with carrying the weight around. He is over four stone down now, and the habits that got him there are not going anywhere.

Down 10kg
Jodie

Her last coaches took the money and vanished.

She had paid for coaching before. Barely a check in, no progress, nobody who seemed to care either way. By the time she came to me she hated the gym. She is 10kg down with real muscle on her, she actually enjoys training now, and she is comfortable in her own skin for the first time.

Built the physique
Adam

Joiner, on the go, living on whatever was quickest.

He never had time to get his food in properly, so he would run on empty all day then binge at night. Weekends were a write off on the booze. He told me his life felt like a mess. We sorted the food around his actual work day first and the shape followed after. Twenty weeks, start to finish.

Leaner & bigger
David

Actuary by day, lifter by night.

He was already in the gym and putting the work in. What he did not have was any structure or habits that fitted the way he actually lived. Same effort, organised properly, and he got into the best shape of his life.

Lost the belly
Alaric

A VP in banking who was scared of the gym.

Back to back meetings, a torn ACL he was wary of, and a belly he had stopped looking at. We trained around the knee instead of avoiding everything, and the belly went with it. He has been with me two years now.

100→160kg deadlift
Reiss

Shaky reps to clean reps. Sixty kilos added to his deadlift in twelve weeks.

"

Alaric's wife pulled me aside one day and said he doesn't snore anymore. They're sleeping properly for the first time in years. That hit me harder than any transformation photo ever could. The body change is one thing. His wife being able to sleep is another thing entirely.

What this actually does for you

You stop guessing. You start feeling like yourself again.

Not a plan you download and work out on your own. Coaching, with someone actually looking at it.

01

Every session, planned.

Open your phone. Sets, weights and rest are already there. You just train.

02

Nothing goes unchecked.

You send the training and the food. I go through all of it and tell you what changes.

03

Built around your week.

Three sessions a week, forty five minutes each. Around the job, not instead of it.

04

Felt before it's seen.

Energy and sleep move first. The mirror follows.

The difference

What half of them do, and what I do instead.

Most online coaching
  • A team, and you get whoever has space that month
  • A programme in an app, then you are on your own
  • A check in form nobody really reads
  • Only the good weeks ever get posted
  • A system with a name on it, sold to everyone the same
  • An injury means stop, rather than train around it
What you get here
  • Me. The same coach every single week
  • Your training videos watched, frame by frame
  • Your food and your sleep gone through every seven days
  • Told straight when something is not working
  • Built around your job, your injuries and your gym
  • Trained back to strong, not told to take it easy

Ask Mark about the weeks his scale did not move. That bit never makes it onto anyone else's page.
